summaryZh: 瑞士厂商 Ecorobotix 在荷兰 ATH 农机展上首次公开展示 12 米宽的 ARA 1200 点喷除草机原型机。该机重 2000 公斤，采用折叠式设计，核心技术沿用 6 米版 ARA 620，并新增负载感应液压控制盒。ARA 1200 售价约 21 万欧元，另有 9 米版 ARA 900 约 18 万欧元。本季产能已售罄，全球将部署约 20 台。该产品代表了大田精准植保机器人向更大幅宽、更高效率方向发展的趋势。

contentFull:
Prototype Ecorobotix ARA 1200 makes debut at ATH

 17-09 | Field robots | News

LinkedInFacebookXWhatsAppPrint

The Ecorobotix ARA 1200 spot sprayer on display at the AgroTechniek Holland (ATH) trade fair in Biddinghuizen (Fl.) is still at the prototype stage. Photo: Mark Pasveer

Swiss manufacturer Ecorobotix is exhibiting a new 12-metre-wide ARA 1200 spot sprayer at the AgroTechniek Holland (ATH) trade fair. It is the first time the manufacturer has shown the machine to the public.

The Ecorobotix ARA 1200 on display at machinery trade fair ATH in Biddinghuizen is still at the prototype stage. Under the covers, however, the basic design is virtually final, although the cables, among other things, still need to be finished more neatly. Notably, the 12-metre-wide machine folds to a narrower transport width than the ARA 620.

Read on below the photo

The manufacturer says the machine will be finished more neatly under the covers. The supporting structure will not change much. Photo: Jacco van ErkelensControl box for hydraulic functions

The machine weighs 2,000 kg and has a wheel set at the rear. For transport, the centre sections fold upwards and the outer sections fold downwards. This positions the white protective cover on the outside and protects the spray nozzles underneath. The technology under the covers is identical to that of the already familiar 6-metre version. A new control box has now been added. Using load sensing, this box allows all hydraulic functions to be operated, such as folding in and out and locking the support wheels.

9-metre-wide version on the way

In addition to the ARA 1200 version, Ecorobotix is also introducing a 9-metre-wide version. The ARA 1200 will cost around €210,000. The ARA 900 will cost about €180,000. By comparison, the ARA 620 costs €134,000. The machines can be ordered, but are no longer available for delivery before next season. The available machines for that period have already sold out. Ecorobotix will deploy around 20 machines worldwide. According to the manufacturer, they are being rolled out to end customers at a steady pace so that service remains manageable.

translationZh:
瑞士制造商 Ecorobotix 正在 AgroTechniek Holland（ATH）贸易展上展出新型 12 米宽的 ARA 1200 点喷除草机。这是该制造商首次向公众展示该机器。

在 Biddinghuizen 举行的 ATH 农机展上展出的 Ecorobotix ARA 1200 仍处于原型阶段。不过，在覆盖件之下，基本设计实际上已基本定型，尽管电缆等部分仍需整理得更加规整。值得注意的是，这台 12 米宽的机器折叠后的运输宽度比 ARA 620 更窄。

**液压功能控制盒**

该机器重 2000 公斤，后部配有一组轮子。运输时，中间段向上折叠，外侧段向下折叠。这样可以将白色防护罩置于外侧，保护下方的喷头。覆盖件下的技术与人们已经熟悉的 6 米版本相同。现在新增了一个控制盒。该控制盒利用负载感应技术，可操作所有液压功能，如折叠展开和支撑轮锁定。

**9 米宽版本即将推出**

除 ARA 1200 版本外，Ecorobotix 还推出了 9 米宽版本。ARA 1200 售价约为 21 万欧元。ARA 900 售价约为 18 万欧元。相比之下，ARA 620 售价为 13.4 万欧元。这些机器可以订购，但下一季之前已无法交付。该时段可供应的机器已经售罄。Ecorobotix 将在全球部署约 20 台机器。据制造商称，这些机器正以稳定的节奏交付给终端客户，以便服务保持可控。
